command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=bfebcc94cb7e50786bd8287682b1082cc66001f4; PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f sdkconfig.old; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test -e "$PORT"; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; grep -q '^CONFIG_IDF_TARGET="esp32c6"' sdkconfig; grep -q '^CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ESP32C6=y' sdkconfig; grep -q '^IDF_TARGET:STRING=esp32c6' build/CMakeCache.txt; echo '=== INCREMENTAL BUILD ESP32C6 ==='; idf.py build; test -e "$PORT"; echo '=== FLASH ESP32C6 (NO ERASE) ==='; idf.py -p "$PORT" flash; echo '=== WAIT FOR C6 PORT ==='; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ -e "$PORT" ] && break; sleep 0.5; done; test -e "$PORT"; echo '=== SERIAL 150S / help / permit 180 ==='; python - <<'PY'
import serial, time, sys
port='/dev/cu.usbmodem1101'
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=port
s.baudrate=115200
s.timeout=0.20
s.write_timeout=1
s.dtr=False
s.rts=False
s.open()
start=time.monotonic()
end=start+150
sent_help=False
sent_permit=False
try:
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        if not sent_help and elapsed>=3:
            s.write(b'help\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: help', flush=True); sent_help=True
        if not sent_permit and elapsed>=6:
            s.write(b'permit 180\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: permit 180', flush=True); sent_permit=True
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
finally:
    s.close()
PY
rm -f sdkconfig.old; git restore --source=HEAD -- dependencies.lock 2>/dev/null || true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
